run_benchmark: run a concurrent LLM generation benchmark measuring tokens per second across multiple parallel calls
find_pad_len: find the exact padding length needed to reach a target prompt token count using binary search
run_sweep: run a decode ratio sweep benchmark and append results as JSON to a file
complete_chat: send a chat completion request to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with custom extra body kwargs
make_messages: create a chat message list with a padded user prompt for benchmarking token counts
